principle: Each module is assessed independently; absent or inconclusive benefit evidence keeps it optional, and equivalent outcomes favor the simpler arm.

modules.observed: The evaluator found the seeded arithmetic defect without changing the checkout.
modules.limitation: No matched human-review-only arm measured incremental findings, effort, or false positives.

modules.control: competent bounded source retrieval without graph context
modules.observed: Both completed arms delivered 33 accepted changes; graph cost per accepted change was 0.256874 versus 0.240477 without graph.
modules.limitation: Small samples and one verification failure in the without-graph arm do not establish universal reliability.

modules.observed: Neither calibration arm delivered an accepted change; the driver stopped once and cost was not comparable because native billing was incomplete.
modules.limitation: This failed calibration establishes no productivity benefit.

modules.treatment: harness selection and coordination metadata on the same worktrees
modules.observed: Two real worktrees preserved independent scope and caught an integration defect.
modules.limitation: Correctness is proven, but no paired team outcome shows benefit over native Git worktrees.

modules.control: scheduled and manually dispatched bounded evals
modules.observed: Live model execution is explicit workflow dispatch; scheduled work is bounded and deterministic by default.
modules.limitation: No continuous live service was launched because no evidence justified its cost, credentials, or always-on failure surface.
